text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, Tracen Academy will host a 
Halloween party welcoming all the fans. 
The students were busy wrapping up their 
preparations—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeeep~~. Serving team scouted the place 
out, all good to go~.
choice_data_list:
I've got the venue layout memorized 
perfectly!

I've got the venue layout memorized 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just finished meeting with the 
nutritionist! I'm gonna cook up a whole 
bunch of nutritious, buono dishes~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's make it a Marvelous party for 
everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all for the fans who are gathering 
for us, too. The real show is tomorrow. 
Let's make it an absolute success!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous & Bono
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's tomorrow already...? *sigh*
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Not really...

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm Tosen Jordan's mother, and I'll be 
supervising everyone's meals today as a 
registered dietitian. It's a pleasure to 
work with you all.
choice_data_list:
Thank you so much for taking the time to 
meet with me today despite your busy 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You and Jordan are on serving duty, right? 
Let's coordinate closely with the kitchen 
and make this a wonderful party.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I said I get it already...
choice_data_list: We even ran simulations, didn't we.
We even ran simulations, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's reassuring to hear. Now, all that's 
left is to go over each task—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, seriously, enough already! I know way 
more about the academy than you do anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tosen Jordan feels rebellious 
toward her mother. I hope it doesn't turn 
into anything too serious, but—

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And now, let the event begin! Today's 
cooking tips are—
choice_data_list: (Jordan, I hope you're okay...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, stop zoning out!
choice_data_list: Yes! ...Wait, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
? What's with that look? C'mon, wipe down 
the table quick or the customers'll be 
waiting.
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Cleared all the empty plates! Ready for 
the next one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nice timing! The main dish just finished 
cooking!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
While they're serving the food, they 
recommend drinks to you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Here's Akebono's special pumpkin gratin! 
Eat up while it's piping hot!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah, a pumpkin...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're not good with that? Don't force 
yourself, then. Want me to bring you some 
pasta or something?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, after you went out of your way to 
prepare it for me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who wants to hold back and suffer at a 
party? That sucks, right? Here, swap-swap 
with my pasta~!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um! Thanks to you, I had a wonderful time! 
The pasta was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, totally insane, right? Come hang out 
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew, all done~ Didn't I do an insane job?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I think you moved really well out 
there!
Yeah, I think your movement was great!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I can step up when I need to. You 
don't gotta make such a fuss about it.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text: Good work, both of you.
choice_data_list: Ah, thank you for your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mom... you were listening? What, got a 
problem with that—

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, not bad at all. You really worked 
hard today!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You were very quick-witted and worked 
hard. Thanks to you, everyone was able to 
enjoy their meal.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Here, if you'd like. Please 
eat it together, the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, takes me back! It's got that total 
homemade-by-mom vibe~~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Liver and leeks with goya champuru?! 
That's got nothing to do with Halloween! 
Geez—
choice_data_list:
Looks like a side dish that'll help with 
fatigue recovery!

Looks like a side dish that'll help with 
fatigue recovery!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Was that supposed to be appreciation? 
Talk about hard to read."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *chomp*—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Chomp, munch-munch! Nom nom...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... And of course it's lightly 
seasoned like always! Even though you know 
I like rich flavors.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Nutrition, nutrition, nutrition! It's 
always been 'don't eat that' and 'do this' 
since forever!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna praise me, prepare 
something different next time. Heh... 
don't you agree?
choice_data_list:
That home-cooked meal after so long was 
great, wasn't it!

That home-cooked meal after so long was 
great, wasn't it!

It's okay to just be happy about it, you 
know.

I think it's a well-balanced, nutritious 
menu, though

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna praise me, prepare 
something different next time. Heh... 
don't you agree?
choice_data_list:
That home-cooked meal after so long was 
great, wasn't it!

That home-cooked meal after so long was 
great, wasn't it!

It's okay to just be happy about it, you 
know.

I think it's a well-balanced, nutritious 
menu, though

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, try eating it every single day. 
Family restaurants will start looking like 
heaven to you."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, once in a while is fine, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not happy! I only ate it 'cause I was 
starvin'!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What's with that face! Don't look at 
me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's gotta pack a serious punch or 
it's no good!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll LANE Mom. Tell her 'hamburgers next 
time'!
